payload.purpose_context: After the built-in split, the only recorded digest covers the built-in shell, so doctrine edits in member and org packs are not pinned. This mission records a digest sidecar for every pack, verifies all of them in the required gate, and closes the residual manifest-completeness gap from #182.
payload.purpose_tldr: Every pack in the catalogue carries a recorded tree digest that CI verifies, so no pack content can change unnoticed.

payload.wp_title: Manifest lists every file-backed graph node (#182 residual)
Wire the all-pack digest check into the required gate and rename it
Guides, packs README, charter prose and changelog
Record a sidecar digest for every pack
Generic pack digest tool, built-in shim and unit tests
Release archives ship each pack's sidecar
